note: The chapter reports 0.1% DCS in a review of 1,777 military flight crew and paratrooper trainees. An exact event count, role-specific denominators, ascertainment period and repeat-person linkage are unavailable. The chapter cites the 2010 military medicine report about the earlier Italian Air Force training cohort. The 1,777 trainees may include records from the 2003–2009 analysis of 1,241 evaluable trainees. Dates for the 1,777 and participant-level linkage are unavailable, so the rounded rate remains on overlap hold.
